questions.question: Profit of Rs. 25 is made on an article costing Rs.125 What is the profit percentage?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Profit % = (Profit ÷ Cost Price) × 100

= (25 ÷ 125) × 100

= (1 ÷ 5) × 100

= 20%

**∴ Answer = 20%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) = 125

Profit = 25

Selling Price (SP) = 125 + 25 = 150

**Formula used:**

Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100

 CP = 125 Profit = 25 SP = 150 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Profit % = (25 ÷ 125) × 100

⇒ = (1 ÷ 5) × 100

⇒ = 20%

**∴ The correct answer is 20%.**

questions.question: What is the simple interest on ₹5000 for 2 years at 5% per annum?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Net interest percentage = Rate × Time

Net interest percentage = 5% × 2 = 10%

Simple Interest = 10% of 5000

Simple Interest = 500

**∴ Answer = ₹500**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹5000

Time (T) = 2 years

Rate (R) = 5% per annum

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

 
• 
 
 
 
 Start (Year 0)
 Year 1
 Year 2
 P = ₹5000
 

 +5% (₹250)
 

 +5% (₹250)
 
 Total SI = ₹250 + ₹250 = ₹500

**Calculations:**

SI = (5000 × 5 × 2) / 100

⇒ SI = (5000 × 10) / 100
⇒ SI = 50000 / 100
⇒ SI = 500

**∴ The correct answer is ₹500, which is option (1).**

questions.question: Find CI on ₹1000 for 3 years at 10% p.a.?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The effective interest rate for **10%** compounded annually for **3 years** is **33.1%**.

**Compound Interest** = 33.1% of ₹1000

CI = (33.1 ÷ 100) × 1000 = ₹331

**∴ The correct answer is ₹331.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Principal (P)** = ₹1000

**Rate (R)** = 10% per annum

**Time (T)** = 3 years

**Formula Used:**

**Amount (A)** = P(1 + R/100)T

**Compound Interest (CI)** = A − P

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/939052f1502eb892c4e33db31a7550f718c66f10ff16d2585b7d33d1ee4ce125.png] 

⇒ A = 1000 × (1 + 10/100)³

⇒ A = 1000 × (1.1)³

⇒ A = 1000 × 1.331 = ₹1331

⇒ CI = 1331 − 1000 = ₹331

**∴ The correct answer is ₹331.**

**__Additional Information__**

Effective Rate for 3 Years

For a rate R%, the 3-year effective rate is 3R + (3R²/100) + (R³/10000) %.

Difference between CI and SI

For 2 years, Difference = P(R/100)². For 3 years, Difference = P(R/100)² × (3 + R/100).

Compounding Half-Yearly

If interest is compounded semi-annually, the rate is halved (R/2) and the time is doubled (2T).

questions.question: A circular antenna is divided into equal triangular segments by connecting its center to each vertex of a regular polygon. If the polygon has 15 sides, find the sum of all central angles formed.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The central angles of any polygon inscribed in a circle are formed by the radii meeting at the center point.

The sum of all angles around a single central point is always a complete revolution.

Total angle of a complete revolution = 360°.

This sum remains 360° regardless of the number of sides of the polygon.

**∴ Answer = 360°**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of sides of the regular polygon (n) = 15

Shape = Circular antenna divided into equal triangular segments

**Formula used:**

Central angle of one segment = 360° ÷ n

Sum of all central angles = n × (Central angle of one segment)

 
 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 

 θ
 Center
 n = 15 sides
 Sum of Central Angles = 360°

**Calculations:**

Since the circular antenna is divided into 15 equal triangular segments:

⇒ Central angle of each segment = 360° ÷ 15

⇒ Central angle = 24°

⇒ There are 15 such central angles formed at the center.

⇒ Sum of all central angles = 15 × 24°

⇒ Sum = 360°

**∴ The correct answer is (1).**</p

questions.question: Which one of the following is TRUE about repeating decimals?
questions.solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Repeating decimals (like 0.333...) can always be expressed in the form of p/q where p, q are integers and q ≠ 0. By definition, any number that can be written as a fraction p/q is a Rational Number. Non-terminating but repeating decimals = Rational Numbers. Non-terminating and non-repeating decimals = Irrational Numbers. **∴ Answer = Always rational**

questions.question: A hollow pipe is 1.2 meters long and has an inner radius of 3 cm and outer radius of 4 cm. Find the volume of material used in the pipe.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert length to centimeters: 1.2 m = 120 cm.

Area of material cross-section = π × (Outer Radius² − Inner Radius²).

Difference in radius squares = 4² − 3² = 16 − 9 = 7.

Volume = 7 × 120 × π = 840π.

**∴ Answer = 840π cm³**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of the pipe (h) = 1.2 m = 120 cm

Inner radius (r) = 3 cm

Outer radius (R) = 4 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of material in a hollow pipe = π × (R² − r²) × h

 
 
 
• R=4 
• r=3 
• h = 120 cm Volume = π(R² − r²)h 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume = π × (4² − 3²) × 120

⇒ Volume = π × (16 − 9) × 120

⇒ Volume = π × 7 × 120

⇒ Volume = 840π cm³

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**

questions.question: A prism-shaped chocolate box has an equilateral triangular base of side 12 cm and a height of 25 cm. If 25 such boxes are packed in a crate, what is the total surface area of all the boxes, including their tops and bottoms? (Use sqrt{3} = 1.732)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Base Area** = (√3 / 4) × 12² = 1.732 × 36 = 62.352 cm²

**Lateral Surface Area** = Perimeter × height = (3 × 12) × 25 = 900 cm²

**TSA per box** = 900 + (2 × 62.352) = 1024.704 cm²

**Total Area for 25 boxes** = 25 × 1024.704 = 25617.6 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 25617.6 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Base side of the **equilateral triangular base** (s) = 12 cm

**Height** of the prism (h) = 25 cm

Number of boxes (n) = 25

Value of √3 = 1.732

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/254794f2d94530a1c0708a0cf644f6b69e6dbbf3c5224ec797859f29d68aadfa.png] 

**Formula Used:**

**Total Surface Area (TSA)** of a prism = **Lateral Surface Area** + 2 × **Base Area**

**Lateral Surface Area (LSA)** = Perimeter of base × Height

**Area of Equilateral Triangle** = (√3 / 4) × side²

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area of one triangular base = (1.732 / 4) × 12 × 12

⇒ Area of one triangular base = 1.732 × 36 = 62.352 cm²

⇒ Perimeter of the base = 3 × 12 = 36 cm

⇒ LSA of one box = 36 × 25 = 900 cm²

⇒ TSA of one box = 900 + 2 × 62.352

⇒ TSA of one box = 900 + 124.704 = 1024.704 cm²

⇒ TSA of 25 such boxes = 25 × 1024.704

⇒ TSA of 25 boxes = 25617.6 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 25617.6 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of a Prism

A prism is a polyhedron with two congruent and parallel faces called bases. The **volume** of any prism is calculated as (Area of base × Height).

Lateral Surface Area (LSA)

The LSA of a prism is the area of all its side faces, which equals the (Perimeter of the base × height of the prism).

Equilateral Triangle formulas

For a side 's', the height is (√3 / 2)s and the area is (√3 / 4)s². All internal angles are 60°.</p

questions.question: A hemisphere and a cone have the same base radius and same height. What is the ratio of their volumes?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

For a **hemisphere**, the **height** is always equal to its **radius** (h = r).

Since the **cone** has the same **height** and **radius**, its height (h) is also equal to (r).

Volume Ratio = (2/3 π r³) : (1/3 π r² × r) = 2 : 1.

**∴ The correct answer is 2:1.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Base **radius** of hemisphere = Base **radius** of cone = r

**Height** of hemisphere = **Height** of cone = h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f20a6514ab86294952578cac190a8387bd640cc35cae4ce2e601e5c3db718276.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a **hemisphere** (V₁) = 2/3 π r³

Volume of a **cone** (V₂) = 1/3 π r² h

**Calculations:**

⇒ In a hemisphere, the distance from the center of the base to the top is its **radius**.

⇒ ∴ Height of hemisphere (h) = r

⇒ Since both have the same height, Height of cone (h) = r

⇒ Volume of cone (V₂) = 1/3 π r² × r = 1/3 π r³

⇒ Ratio = V₁ : V₂ = (2/3 π r³) : (1/3 π r³)

⇒ Ratio = 2/3 : 1/3 = 2 : 1

**∴ The correct answer is 2:1.**

**__Additional Information__**

Volume of Sphere

The volume of a complete **sphere** is given by 4/3 π r³, which is exactly double that of a hemisphere.

Surface Area of Hemisphere

**Curved Surface Area (CSA)** = 2π r² and **Total Surface Area (TSA)** = 3π r².

Volume of Cylinder

The volume of a **cylinder** with the same radius and height would be π r² h = π r³, making the ratio Cylinder : Hemisphere : Cone = 3 : 2 : 1.</p

questions.question: A parallelogram has sides of 22 cm and 16 cm. The angle between them is 45^circ. Find the exact area of the parallelogram and the height corresponding to the longer side.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Area of Parallelogram = Side₁ × Side₂ × sin(θ)

Area = 22 × 16 × sin(45°) = 352 × (1/√2) = 176√2 cm²

Height (h) = Area ÷ Base = 176√2 ÷ 22 = 8√2 cm

**∴ Answer = 176√2 cm², 8√2 cm**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sides of the parallelogram: a = 22 cm, b = 16 cm

Angle between the sides: θ = 45°

**Formula used:**

Area = Side₁ × Side₂ × sin(θ)

Area = Base × Height

 
 
• 
 45° Base (a) = 22 cm Side (b) = 16 cm h Area = 176√2 cm² 

**Calculations:**

Area = 22 × 16 × sin(45°)

⇒ Area = 352 × (1/√2)

⇒ Area = (352 ÷ √2) × (√2 ÷ √2) = 176√2 cm²

⇒ Height corresponding to the longer side (h) × 22 = 176√2

⇒ h = 176√2 ÷ 22 = 8√2 cm

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**

questions.question: A spherical ball of radius 24 cm is melted and recast into identical hemispheres, each having a radius of 8 cm. Determine the combined curved surface area of all hemispheres.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Number of hemispheres (n) = (Volume of Sphere) ÷ (Volume of Hemisphere)

n = [4/3 × π × R³] ÷ [2/3 × π × r³] = 2 × (R/r)³

n = 2 × (24/8)³ = 2 × 3³ = 2 × 27 = 54

Total CSA = n × 2πr² = 54 × 2 × π × 8² = 108 × 64π = 6912π

**∴ The correct answer is 6912π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Radius of the **spherical ball** (R) = 24 cm, Radius of each **hemisphere** (r) = 8 cm.

**Formula Used:** Volume of sphere = 4/3 πR³ | Volume of hemisphere = 2/3 πr³ | CSA of hemisphere = 2πr²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3b3cdf1fd833b3930ab59b91932017bb436f30fe6a9ab82b1630daf7f177e15.png] 

⇒ Volume of the original **sphere** = 4/3 × π × (24)³ cm³

⇒ Volume of one **hemisphere** = 2/3 × π × (8)³ cm³

⇒ Let **n** be the number of hemispheres formed.

⇒ n × [2/3 × π × 8 × 8 × 8] = 4/3 × π × 24 × 24 × 24

⇒ n = [4 × 24 × 24 × 24] ÷ [2 × 8 × 8 × 8] = 2 × 3 × 3 × 3 = 54

⇒ **Combined Curved Surface Area** (CSA) = n × 2πr²

⇒ Total CSA = 54 × 2 × π × (8)² = 108 × 64π

⇒ Total CSA = 6912π cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 6912π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Surface Area of a Sphere

A sphere only has one surface area, which is 4πr², where r is the radius.

Total Surface Area of a Hemisphere

The total surface area (TSA) includes the curved area (2πr²) and the flat base area (πr²), totaling 3πr².

Volume Invariance

When a solid object is melted and recast into other shapes, its **Total Volume** remains constant (VolumeIₙᵢₜᵢₐₗ = VolumeFᵢₙₐₗ).

Volume of Sphere vs Hemisphere

A hemisphere is exactly half of a sphere; thus, its volume is 2/3 πr³ compared to the sphere's 4/3 πr³.</p

questions.question: Chetan invested Rs. 9,000 for 12 months, and Sahir invested Rs. 6,000 for 6 months. If the total profit of the business is Rs. 18,000, how much will Chetan receive?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Profit Ratio (Chetan : Sahir) = (9,000 × 12) : (6,000 × 6)

Ratio = 108,000 : 36,000 = 3 : 1

Total Ratio units = 3 + 1 = 4 units

Value of 4 units = ₹18,000 → 1 unit = ₹4,500

Chetan share = 3 units = 3 × 4,500 = 13,500

**∴ Answer = ₹13,500**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Chetan investment = ₹9,000 | Time = 12 months

Sahir investment = ₹6,000 | Time = 6 months

Total business profit = ₹18,000

**Formula used:**

Profit Share Ratio = (Investment₁ × Time₁) : (Investment₂ × Time₂)

 Profit Distribution Bar Chetan (3 units) Sahir (1) 
• Total Profit = ₹18,000 (4 Units) Chetan Share = (3/4) × 18,000 = ₹13,500 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Profit Ratio = (9,000 × 12) : (6,000 × 6)

⇒ Profit Ratio = 108,000 : 36,000

⇒ Simplified Ratio = 3 : 1

⇒ Total profit share parts = 3 + 1 = 4

⇒ Chetan share = (3 ÷ 4) × 18,000

⇒ Chetan share = 3 × 4,500 = 13,500

**∴ The correct answer is ₹13,500 (Option 4).**

questions.question: If tantheta =1, find sintheta +costheta .
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If tan θ = 1, then the angle θ = 45°.

Standard values: sin 45° = 1/√2 and cos 45° = 1/√2.

Sum = sin 45° + cos 45° = 1/√2 + 1/√2 = 2/√2 = √2.

**∴ Answer = √2**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

tan θ = 1

**Formula used:**

tan θ = Perpendicular (P) / Base (B)

Hypotenuse (H) = √(P² + B²)

sin θ = P / H and cos θ = B / H

 
 
 
 θ Base (B) = 1 P = 1 H = √(12 + 12) = √2 

**Calculations:**

⇒ tan θ = 1 / 1 → Perpendicular (P) = 1 and Base (B) = 1

⇒ Hypotenuse (H) = √(1² + 1²) = √2

⇒ sin θ = P / H = 1 / √2

⇒ cos θ = B / H = 1 / √2

⇒ sin θ + cos θ = (1 / √2) + (1 / √2)

⇒ Result = 2 / √2 = √2

**∴ The correct answer is (1).**

questions.question: If sin{x} = (3)/(5) and X is in Quadrant II, what is the value of Cosx?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since sin x = 3/5, we use the Pythagorean triplet (3, 4, 5) where Perpendicular = 3 and Hypotenuse = 5.

The magnitude of the Base (Adjacent side) = √(5² − 3²) = 4.

In Quadrant II, sine is positive but cosine is negative (ASTC rule).

Therefore, cos x = −Base/Hypotenuse = −4/5.

**∴ Answer = −4/5**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

sin x = 3/5 and x is in Quadrant II.

**Formula used:**

cos x = ±√(1 − sin²x)

 
• 
• 
 
 x Base = −4 Perp = 3 Hyp = 5 Quadrant II cos x = −4/5 (Negative in Q2) 

**Calculations:**

sin x = 3/5

⇒ cos²x = 1 − sin²x

⇒ cos²x = 1 − (3/5)²

⇒ cos²x = 1 − 9/25 = 16/25

⇒ cos x = ±√(16/25) = ±4/5

⇒ Since x lies in Quadrant II (90° < x < 180°), cosine must be negative.

⇒ cos x = −4/5

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**

questions.question: Two pipes of length 1.5 meters and 1.2 meters are to be cut into equal pieces without leaving any extra length. What is the greatest length of pieces of the same size that can be cut from both pipes?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To find the greatest common length, calculate the HCF of the given values.

Lengths are 1.5 and 1.2.

Ignore decimal: HCF(15, 12) = 3.

Place decimal back: 0.3.

**∴ Answer = 0.3 meter**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of Pipe 1 = 1.5 meters

Length of Pipe 2 = 1.2 meters

**Formula used:**

Greatest length of pieces = HCF(Length₁, Length₂)

 Pipe 1: 1.5 m 
• 
• 
• 
• Pipe 2: 1.2 m 
• 
• 
• 0.3m 0.3m 0.3m 0.3m 0.3m Greatest Piece Length = 0.3 m 

**Calculations:**

Convert the lengths to a common unit to avoid decimals (centimeters):

⇒ Length 1 = 1.5 × 100 = 150 cm

⇒ Length 2 = 1.2 × 100 = 120 cm

Find the HCF of 150 and 120:

⇒ 150 = 30 × 5

⇒ 120 = 30 × 4

⇒ HCF(150, 120) = 30 cm

Convert back to meters:

⇒ 30 cm = 30 ÷ 100 = 0.3 meter

**∴ The correct answer is 0.3 meter (Option 2).**

questions.question: A 40 litre solution contains 25% salt. How many litres of water must be evaporated so that the concentration of salt becomes 40%?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since the quantity of salt remains constant: Initial Volume × Initial % = Final Volume × Final %

40 × 25% = Final Volume × 40%

Final Volume = (40 × 25) ÷ 40 = 25 L

Water to be evaporated = Initial Volume − Final Volume = 40 − 25 = 15 L

**∴ Answer = 15 L**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial solution volume = 40 L

Initial salt concentration = 25%

Target salt concentration = 40%

**Formula used:**

Quantity of solute = Total Volume × (Concentration Percentage ÷ 100)

 Initial: 40L (Salt 25%) Salt 10L Water 30L 
• Final: 25L (Salt 40%) Salt 10L Evaporated: 15L Water Lost = 40L − 25L = 15L 

**Calculations:**

Initial quantity of salt = 40 × (25 ÷ 100) = 40 × (1 ÷ 4)

⇒ Salt = 10 L

⇒ Let the quantity of water evaporated be x litres.

⇒ New total volume = 40 − x

⇒ Since only water evaporates, salt remains 10 L.

⇒ 40% of (40 − x) = 10

⇒ (40 ÷ 100) × (40 − x) = 10

⇒ (2 ÷ 5) × (40 − x) = 10

⇒ 80 − 2x = 50

⇒ 2x = 30

⇒ x = 15 L

**∴ The correct answer is 15 L, which is option (2).**

questions.question: A painter is hired to paint a wall with a special shade. To prepare the paint, he mixes red, blue, and white in the ratio 4:2:1. For this design, he prepares 14 liters of paint in total. How many liters of white paint does he use?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Red : Blue : White = 4 : 2 : 1

Total ratio parts = 4 + 2 + 1 = 7 units

Total paint = 14 liters

1 unit = 14 ÷ 7 = 2 liters

White paint is 1 unit = 2 liters

**∴ Answer = 2**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of Red, Blue, and White paint = 4 : 2 : 1

Total volume of paint mixture = 14 liters

**Formula used:**

Quantity of a specific part = (Component Ratio ÷ Sum of Ratios) × Total Quantity

 Red (4) Blue (2) W (1) 
• 
• 
• Total = 14 Liters (7 units) Paint Mixture Ratio 4 : 2 : 1 
 White Paint? 

**Calculations:**

Sum of ratios = 4 + 2 + 1 = 7

⇒ Total quantity representing 7 units = 14 liters

⇒ Value of 1 unit = 14 ÷ 7

⇒ Value of 1 unit = 2 liters

⇒ Quantity of white paint used (1 unit) = 1 × 2 = 2 liters

**∴ The correct answer is 2 (Option 2).**

questions.question: Three vessels X, Y, and Z hold liquid in the capacity ratio of 3:4:5. Each vessel contains a mixture of juice and water, where the proportions are 1:2 in X, 3:1 in Y, and 2:3 in Z. If the entire contents of these vessels are emptied into one large container and mixed uniformly, what will be the overall ratio of juice to water in the combined mixture?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Observe that the **sum of ratio parts** for each vessel matches the **capacity ratio** parts.

Vessel X: 1 + 2 = 3 parts | Vessel Y: 3 + 1 = 4 parts | Vessel Z: 2 + 3 = 5 parts.

Since the capacity ratio is exactly **3:4:5**, we can directly sum the components.

Total **Juice** = 1 + 3 + 2 = 6 units

Total **Water** = 2 + 1 + 3 = 6 units

Overall ratio = 6 : 6 = 1 : 1

**∴ The correct answer is 1:1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Capacity ratio of vessels **X : Y : Z = 3 : 4 : 5**.

Ratio of **Juice : Water** in X = 1 : 2, in Y = 3 : 1, and in Z = 2 : 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2710d3c8df829fd94e32199b968a33840a0a7dfb19d8866958317d0ecd52ec48.png] 

Let the capacities of vessels **X, Y, and Z** be 3, 4, and 5 units respectively.

Quantity of **Juice** in X = 3 × (1/3) = 1 unit

Quantity of **Water** in X = 3 × (2/3) = 2 units

Quantity of **Juice** in Y = 4 × (3/4) = 3 units

Quantity of **Water** in Y = 4 × (1/4) = 1 unit

Quantity of **Juice** in Z = 5 × (2/5) = 2 units

Quantity of **Water** in Z = 5 × (3/5) = 3 units

⇒ Total **Juice** in combined container = 1 + 3 + 2 = 6 units

⇒ Total **Water** in combined container = 2 + 1 + 3 = 6 units

⇒ Required Ratio = 6 : 6 = 1 : 1

**∴ The correct answer is 1:1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mixture Concentration

The concentration of a component in a mixture is given by (Quantity of component) ÷ (Total quantity of mixture).

Volume Normalization Rule

If capacity ratios and internal ratios are different, find the **LCM** of the sum of parts (3, 4, 5 in this case) to normalize the volumes before mixing.

Compound Ratio

When multiple mixtures are combined, the final ratio is the sum of weighted components: Jfᵢₙₐₗ : Wfᵢₙₐₗ = Σ(Vᵢ × Jᵢ/Tᵢ) : Σ(Vᵢ × Wᵢ/Tᵢ).</p

questions.question: If tan(A) = cot(B), what is the relationship between angle A and angle B?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

For any two complementary angles, the tan of one equals the cot of the other.

Property: tan θ = cot(90° − θ)

Given: tan A = cot B ⇒ tan A = tan(90° − B)

Equating angles: A = 90° − B ⇒ A + B = 90°

**∴ Answer = A + B = 90°**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Trigonometric equation: tan A = cot B

**Formula used:**

cot θ = tan(90° − θ)

 

 
 90°

 A
 Adjacent to A (AC)
 Opposite to A (BC)
 tan A = BC/AC | cot B = BC/AC

**Calculations:**

We are given the relation: tan A = cot B

⇒ Using the complementary angle identity: cot B = tan(90° − B)

⇒ tan A = tan(90° − B)

⇒ Comparing the angles: A = 90° − B

⇒ A + B = 90°

In a right-angled triangle, the two acute angles A and B always satisfy A + B = 90°.

**∴ The correct answer is (1).**</p

questions.question: (sqrt{11}+2)times(sqrt{11}-2) = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply the standard identity: (a + b)(a − b) = a² − b²

Here, a = √11 and b = 2.

Expression = (√11)² − (2)²

Result = 11 − 4 = 7

**∴ Answer = 7**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Mathematical expression: (√11 + 2) × (√11 − 2)

**Formula used:**

(a + b) × (a − b) = a² − b²

**Calculations:**

The expression is in the form of (a + b)(a − b) where:

⇒ a = √11

⇒ b = 2

⇒ Result = a² − b²

⇒ Result = (√11)² − (2)²

⇒ Result = 11 − 4

⇒ Result = 7

**∴ The correct answer is 7 (Option 1).**

questions.question: If sqrt{a} + sqrt{b} = 12 and sqrt{a} - sqrt{b} = 4, then what is the value of a + b?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let x = √a and y = √b.

x = (Sum + Difference) ÷ 2 = (12 + 4) ÷ 2 = 8.

y = (Sum − Difference) ÷ 2 = (12 − 4) ÷ 2 = 4.

a = 8² = 64 and b = 4² = 16.

a + b = 64 + 16 = 80.

**∴ Answer = 80**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

√a + √b = 12

√a − √b = 4

**Formula used:**

(x + y)² + (x − y)² = 2(x² + y²)

 
• √a = 8 √b = 4 Sum (√a + √b) = 12 √a = 8 √b = 4 
 Diff (√a − √b) = 4 Result: a + b = 64 + 16 = 80 

**Calculations:**

Let x = √a and y = √b

⇒ (x + y)² + (x − y)² = 2(x² + y²)

⇒ 12² + 4² = 2((√a)² + (√b)²)

⇒ 144 + 16 = 2(a + b)

⇒ 160 = 2(a + b)

⇒ a + b = 160 ÷ 2

⇒ a + b = 80

**∴ The correct answer is 80, which is option (3).**

questions.question: The difference between simple interest on a certain sum at the annual rate of 15 percent for 6 years and 7 years is Rs 75. What is the sum?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Rate = 15%

Time difference = 1 year

Difference in interest = 75

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest = (Principal × Rate × Time) ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Difference in SI for 1 year = (Principal × 15 × 1) ÷ 100

⇒ 75 = (Principal × 15) ÷ 100

⇒ Principal = (75 × 100) ÷ 15

⇒ = 500

**∴ The correct answer is 500.**

questions.question: There are 4 numbers N1, N2, N3 and N4. Average of N1, N2 and N3 is 30 and Average of N2, N3 and N4 is 26 Value of N1 28 is What is the value of N4?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of N1, N2, N3 = 30

Average of N2, N3, N4 = 26

N1 = 28

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of terms ÷ Number of terms

**Calculation:**

⇒ N1 + N2 + N3 = 30 × 3

⇒ = 90

⇒ 28 + N2 + N3 = 90

⇒ N2 + N3 = 90 − 28

⇒ = 62

⇒ N2 + N3 + N4 = 26 × 3

⇒ = 78

⇒ 62 + N4 = 78

⇒ N4 = 78 − 62

⇒ = 16

**∴ The correct answer is 16.**
